nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate change adaptation strategies|Sustainable fisheries management_qna_000
nodes.label: Science and Tech
nodes.question: What are some environmental variables that can influence the dynamics of fish resources?
nodes.answer: Climatic events and underlying drivers are environmental variables that have the potential to alter the dynamics of fish resources in the marine ecosystem.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate change adaptation strategies|Sustainable fisheries management_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What organization published a report on the impacts of climate change on fisheries and aquaculture?
nodes.answer: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations published a report on the impacts of climate change on fisheries and aquaculture.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate change adaptation strategies|Sustainable fisheries management_qna_002
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What changes in hunting practices have been observed since 1991?
nodes.answer: Trade and gun hunting have increased since 1991.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate change adaptation strategies|Sustainable fisheries management_qna_003
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: How much did global fish importation increase from 1990 to 2021?
nodes.answer: Global fish importation increased by 154.39% from 1990 to 2021.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate change adaptation strategies|Sustainable fisheries management_qna_004
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What long-term mitigating effects do changes in technology and innovation have on fish footprint?
nodes.answer: Changes in technology and innovation have long-term mitigating effects on fish footprint.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate change adaptation strategies|Sustainable fisheries management_qna_005
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What are some of the impacts of climate change on fisheries and aquaculture according to the sources cited in the text?
nodes.answer: According to the sources cited, climate change has impacts on fisheries such as vulnerability of the least developed countries, synthesis of current knowledge, and adaptation and mitigation options for fisheries and aquaculture.
